summary: Sandbach United fell to a 3-2 defeat against Foley Meir in what proved a frustrating encounter, with the Bach squandering several clear-cut chances and conceding from soft free kicks. Saul Shotton's fine far post volley gave them hope late on, but it wasn't quite enough as the opposition keeper made crucial saves when it mattered. The side will look to bounce back when they face Stafford Town on Saturday.
